31d43ec70a.q: What conditions should patients go to the emergency room for instead of urgent care?
31d43ec70a.a: Chest pain, stroke symptoms such as slurred speech and facial droop, and any time-sensitive cardiac issues should go to the ER. If you come to urgent care with chest pain, you've already used up valuable time while an EKG is performed before being sent to the ER anyway. People with comorbidities experiencing chest pain should normally go directly to the ER.
